purpose: Teach: 如何なる/原著/生い立ち/懇願/物言い/卵子/破局/公道

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、如何なる症状でも、医療チームで真摯に対応します
lines.en: Ren — whatever symptoms you have, our medical team will respond to them with complete sincerity.
lines.style: Clear, measured opening. Even pacing, professional but not cold. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone who means exactly what she says and says no more.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医学書の原著を医療チームで原文で読み合わせします
lines.en: Ren — we read the original medical literature together as a team, in the source language, so nothing gets lost in translation.
lines.style: Same steady baseline. Slight emphasis on 「原文で」— the precision matters. Methodical. Not explaining down to him, but laying out the standard she holds.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様の生い立ちを医療チームで丁寧に伺います
lines.en: Ren — and we listen carefully to each patient's full history, your full history, with genuine attention.
lines.style: Softer edge now, still controlled. The word 「丁寧に」 opens a small window into her care. Unhurried pacing. A pause before continuing, acknowledging the weight of listening.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ご家族からの治療懇願に応える事を医療チームで考えます
lines.en: Ren — when your family asks something of us, we think about how to answer that in a way that honors what they're asking.
lines.style: Warmth under the surface now, but not performed. Slight slowdown on 「応える」. She's speaking from principle, not protocol. Still grounded, still professional.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、診断への物言い、つまりセカンドオピニオンを医療チームで尊重します
lines.en: Ren — if you have concerns about the diagnosis, if you want a second opinion, we respect that. Our team supports it.
lines.style: Direct and clear. No defensiveness. Light emphasis on 「尊重します」. She's giving permission he might not have known he needed. Even tempo, no waver.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 不妊治療の卵子採取を、貴院、安全におこなわれますね、先生
lines.en: So about the egg retrieval for the fertility treatment — your hospital does perform it safely, right, Doctor?
lines.style: Quieter than before. Cautious opening, searching for reassurance beneath the polite phrasing. Slight hesitation before the question mark. The honorific 「先生」 at the end carries both respect and vulnerability — he needs her to answer this one carefully.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、感染拡大の破局的シナリオを医療チームで想定します
lines.en: Ren — we prepare for worst-case scenarios with pandemic spread. Our team thinks through those catastrophic possibilities so we're ready.
lines.style: Back to her measured professional baseline, but there's a weight underneath now. She's being honest about contingency without alarming. Deliberate pacing on the hard words. The responsibility of planning for the unthinkable.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、公道での救急搬送を医療チームで支援します
lines.en: Ren — emergency transport on public roads, getting people to us safely — that's something our team coordinates and supports completely.
lines.style: Closing statement. Calm, assured. Slight warmth returns at the end on 「支援します」— commitment, not just procedure. Soft landing, almost a breath of relief that she's reached the end of laying out what they do.
